sources.title: Cedar Dune Trading LLC receives recordkeeping penalty
sources.excerpt: The Fictional Commerce Authority imposed an administrative penalty on Cedar Dune Trading LLC for recordkeeping failures. This is the company notice, not the brokers notice.

sources.title: Cedar Dune Trading LLC fined in securities case
sources.excerpt: The cited Fictional Markets Authority notice instead fines two brokers for their own trades in Cedar Dune Trading LLC shares. The cited notice does not fine the company.

sources.title: Brokers fined over trades in Cedar Dune Trading LLC shares
sources.excerpt: The Fictional Markets Authority imposed penalties on two brokers for their own trading violations. Cedar Dune Trading LLC was not penalized in this notice.

sources.title: Director receives personal tax penalty
sources.excerpt: The Fictional Tax Authority imposed a personal tax penalty on Mira Vale, a director of Cedar Dune Trading LLC. The company is not the penalized party.

sources.title: Cedar Dune Trading LLC announces routine restructuring
sources.excerpt: Cedar Dune Trading LLC announced ten layoffs during a routine restructuring. No misconduct or enforcement action is reported.
